next.reason: 1985: 'MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1 according to the rules specified for the MOVE statement.'; 2023: '`MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1` or `MOVE literal-1 TO record-name-1` according to the rules specified for the MOVE statement.'. Same MOVE-then-WRITE equivalence for identifier-1, but 2023 adds a FROM literal-1 case that the 1985 rule does not have.
